title: Verbal Strategy Quick Reference
tagline: Year 4 — One-page rules for grammar, vocabulary, jumbles, connectors and reading comprehension

introduction.overview: This quick reference gathers the rules that decide most verbal items. Grammar: subject-verb agreement (each, every, neither take singular verbs), tense consistency, parallel structure, prepositions with fixed words, pronoun case. Vocabulary: context clues, tone and roots. Jumbles: opener, links, closer. Connectors: contrast, cause, result, condition. Reading comprehension: structure first, then lines. Use it as a retrieval exercise: cover each rule and recall it.
introduction.placementRelevance: Verbal sections reward knowing a small set of rules well.
introduction.realWorldContext: Clear, correct writing depends on the same rules.

learningObjectives: Order jumbles with openers and links

prerequisiteKnowledge.quickRefresher: Rules beat feelings: apply a rule, then check how it sounds.

coreDefinitions: Agreement: verb matches the subject in number.
Parallelism: items in a list share a form.
Context clue: a hint in the sentence.
Opener: a sentence that starts a paragraph.
Connector: a word showing a relation between ideas.
conceptExplanation.theoreticalIntuition: A few rules explain the majority of errors.
conceptExplanation.visualOrMentalModel: Identify the item type, recall its rule, apply it.

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Fixed prepositions
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: good at, fond of, prefer to

mainNarrative: "Each of the students was given a book": each is singular.
"Neither the teacher nor the students were aware": the verb agrees with the nearer subject.
"He is taller than I am": a comparison needs the full clause.
"I prefer tea to coffee": prefer takes to.
"Hardly had he reached the station when the train left": hardly takes when.

deepDiveAspects.title: Tone in vocabulary
deepDiveAspects.content: A praising sentence rules out negative meanings.

deepDiveAspects.title: RC order of work
deepDiveAspects.content: Read for structure, then answer detail and vocabulary questions first.

solvedExamples.title: Agreement
solvedExamples.question: Each of the students ____ given a book.

solvedExamples.title: Correlative

traditionalVsShortcut.shortcutMethod: Name the item type, recall its rule, apply it, then read the result aloud.

placementTips.eliminationTechnique: Eliminate options that break a rule.

placementTips.recruiterInsight: The same ten rules decide most errors.
